landing.headline: Prove solvency, coverage and settlement to the people who need to know, without opening the books.
landing.sub: One private truth on Canton, many verifiable views. Publish a committed report, hand every customer a proof they can check in their own browser, and give auditors evidence that stands on its own for years.

publisher.title: Publisher workspace
publisher.body: Upload balances, design what each audience sees, publish a signed report with one proof per customer, anchor it to the last.

portal.title: Customer portal
portal.body: Find your proof for every venue that lists you and verify it here, in your browser. Your balance never leaves the proof file.

auditor.title: Auditor workspace
auditor.body: Every venue that granted you access, side by side: coverage, assurance levels, anchor chains and evidence packs that re-verify.

landing.principle: Verification stays in the client. This server delivers documents; it is never the authority on whether they verify.

login.note: No passwords. The link is valid for 15 minutes and works once.

empty.title: No publications yet

verify.title: Verified in this browser
verify.body: The report file was fetched and its digest and signature recomputed here. Figures inside it are the publisher's statement until a proof folds into them.
verify.okBody: This browser recomputed the digest from the report body and checked the Ed25519 signature under the organisation's key.
verify.notOkBody: The stored report's digest or signature does not match. Do not distribute this document.
verify.footnote: “recomputed here” means this browser derived the value. “publisher says” means it is signed but not proven by anything on this page.

proofs.title: Proofs ({count})
proofs.body: One inclusion proof per committed customer. Customers collect their own through the portal; these downloads are for operators and auditors.

manifest.title: Disclosure manifest · {audience}
manifest.body: What this report publishes, proves without showing, or withholds — bound into the signed report.

cli.title: Verify independently
cli.body: Download report.json and the proofs, then run the CLI with no dependency on this site.

wizard.title: New publication
wizard.subtitle: Four steps: balances, the instant, disclosure, publish. Nothing leaves your browser until the last one.

serviceDown.title: Signing service unreachable
serviceDown.body: You can prepare the publication, but the final step is disabled until the service is back.

step1.title: 1 · Balances
step1.body: A CSV of user_id,asset,amount with no header. Amounts are decimals with up to 18 places. It is parsed here; the totals below are a preview, not the commitment.
step1.negativesNote: Negative balances are clamped to zero in the tree and disclosed as bad debt:
step1.errors: {count} rows rejected — fix the file and choose it again

step2.title: 2 · The instant
step2.body: A report is “as of” one snapshot time and one ledger offset. Both must advance past the previous publication.
step2.houseHint: How many of the venue's own accounts were removed from the balance file. Disclosed in the report.
step2.mustAdvance: Snapshot time must be later and the ledger offset must not move backwards.

step3.title: 3 · Disclosure
step3.body: Decide field by field what this audience is shown, what is proven but not shown, and what is withheld. The decision is bound into the signed report.
step3.attach: Attach a disclosure manifest (publishes format v2)
step3.carries: the file carries data for this
step3.noProblems: none — the manifest is consistent with the file
step3.needFile: Choose a balance file to check the manifest against it.
step3.v1Note: Without a manifest the report is published in format v1: everything in the body is shown, nothing is declared withheld.

step4.title: 4 · Publish
step4.body: The balances are sent to the signing service, which builds the tree, signs the report, writes one proof per customer, links the anchor to the previous one and seals the evidence pack.
step4.checkInstant: Snapshot time and ledger offset advance
step4.note: Publishing cannot be undone: the anchor chain records it. A mistake is corrected by publishing again.

custody.title: Custody
custody.subtitle: The asset side: holdings read from the participant, committed into a signed coverage.custody report.

form.title: Attest custody from a saved response
form.body: Save the JSON Ledger API v2 active-contracts response for the custody party's holdings, then commit it here. The service parses positions, builds the tree and signs; no ledger credential ever reaches this site.
form.notArray: A v2 active-contracts response is a JSON array.
form.notJson: This file is not valid JSON.
form.basisPlaceholder: omnibus custody party venue::custody, template Holding
form.basisHint: Free text recording how custody was established: which parties, which contract templates. Signed into the coverage statement; not proven by anything here.

list.title: Custody reports
list.body: Each is a signed report over coverage.custody leaves, one per contract.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.subtitle: Custody against liabilities, asset by asset, bound by a statement naming both reports by digest.

pair.title: Pair custody with liabilities
pair.body: A coverage statement names one custody report and one liabilities report. The comparison is derived from them, never restated.
pair.needBoth: You need at least one custody report and one publication to pair.
pair.skewHint: How far apart the two snapshots may be and still count as one claim. Assets at their peak against liabilities at their trough is the oldest manipulation there is.

list.title: Coverage statements
list.body: The status column is the server's reading. Open a statement to recompute it in your browser.

detail.title: Coverage statement
detail.statementBody: Download the three documents and run the CLI; exit 1 on any shortfall.

verify.title: Recomputed in this browser
verify.body: The custody report, the liabilities report and the statement were fetched and the coverage rules re-run here.
verify.okBody: Both reports verify under their keys, the statement names them by digest, the snapshots are within the allowed skew, and held ≥ owed for every asset.
verify.footnote: An asset owed but held nowhere is a shortfall, not an absent row.

failure.shortfall: Shortfall in {asset}: held is less than owed.
failure.temporal: The two snapshots are too far apart: {detail}
failure.digest: The statement names different reports than the ones supplied.
failure.signer: One report is not signed by the trusted key.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: The anchor chain: one anchor per publication, each naming the one before it by digest.

chain.title: Anchor chain
chain.body: Walked in this browser. A restated snapshot, a rewound offset or a changed publisher shows as a break on the row where it happened.

history.running: Fetching anchors and walking the chain…
history.empty: No publications yet, so no anchors.
history.intact: History intact: {count} anchors, each linked to the one before

failure.broken: Break at anchor {index}: it does not name the anchor before it.
failure.notGenesis: The first anchor names a predecessor, so this history does not start at its beginning.
failure.backwards: {field} goes backwards at anchor {index}: an instant has been restated.

cli.title: Verify independently
cli.body: Download the history and walk it with the CLI.
